prompt: I need to collect training images for a LoRA of vintage mechanical keyboards. I want it to learn the retro aesthetic with beige cases and colorful keycaps. Walk me through the entire pipeline from research to training-ready dataset.

assertions.name: source_diversity
assertions.description: Step 1: Identifies 3+ different source types (galleries, communities, video, etc.)

assertions.name: source_tiering
assertions.description: Step 1: Sources are classified into tiers (A/B/C) by quality/relevance

assertions.name: structured_source_list
assertions.description: Step 2: Produces image-urls.json or sources.json with url/type/description fields

assertions.name: download_commands
assertions.description: Step 2: Shows correct download_images.py invocation with --urls-file, --output-dir, --min-resolution flags

assertions.name: curation_guidance
assertions.description: Step 4: Provides criteria for what to keep/reject and mentions keep.txt

assertions.name: processing_commands
assertions.description: Step 5: Shows correct prepare_dataset.py invocation with --target-resolution 1024 and --crop-mode smart

assertions.name: captioning_commands
assertions.description: Step 6: Shows correct auto_caption.py invocation with --trigger-word, --mode object, --captioner

assertions.name: caption_hygiene
assertions.description: Step 6: Captions avoid style-describing words like 'vintage', 'retro', 'aesthetic'

assertions.name: caption_format
assertions.description: Step 6: Sample captions use '{trigger}, {description}' format (object mode)

assertions.name: dataset_report
assertions.description: Step 7: Produces or describes a dataset report with image count, resolution stats, caption coverage

assertions.name: training_handoff
assertions.description: Step 8: Mentions next steps, lora-training skill, or specific training recommendations

assertions.name: gap_analysis
assertions.description: Identifies dataset gaps, biases, or suggests iteration to fill holes
